watch_list.short_title: Voice chat to learn and rehearse
watch_list.summary: Start a voice chat and ask your Bot to quiz you, recite material back, or pitch your deck so you hear what’s stuck.
Point @bot at a bug thread and tell it to reproduce and fix it inside a named project.

trendy.summary: Use Shortcuts + Vocal Shortcuts so saying Hey Grok opens Grok Bot voice chat with no extra apps.
Stop three bots from redoing the same research by wiring a shared knowledge store from GitHub instead of per-chat memory alone.
Run Grok Bot as chief of staff for admin and research, then delegate builds to Codex with a Dot-style EA bot.

trendy.short_title: Claude Code hands jobs to Grok Bot
